texts.gazette-2513-28: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2513/28 - 2026 යේනාවාැම්බර් මාස 04 වාැනි බදාාදාා - 2026.11.04 No. 2513/28 - WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 04, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE DAMANA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(b) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of a returned member of the Damana Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation; And whereas the Secretary of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Ms. Jinadasa Dias Sandeepa Sewmini Wijegunawardhana the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon a candidate of the Damana Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and who is not disqualified under section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Ms. Marthunga Arachchilage Sanduni Nimesha to fill the said vacancy; Therefore I, Aththanayaka Mudiyanselage Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer of the Damana Pradeshiya Sabha acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(b) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Ms. Marthunga Arachchilage Sanduni Nimesha was elected as the member of the Damana Pradeshiya Sabha. Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer, Damana Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Ampara, 04th November, 2026. EOG 11 – 0029 1A - PG 8134 - 04 (11/2026) PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA. This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
texts.gazette-2513-30: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2513/30 - 2026 යේනාවාැම්බර් මාස 04 වාැනි බදාාදාා - 2026.11.04 No. 2513/30 - WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 04, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE AKKARAIPATTU MUNICIPAL COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(b) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of a returned member of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation; And whereas the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Muslim Congress, the recognized political party to which Ms. Segudeen Rismiya Jahan the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon a candidate of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council who belongs to such party and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared Elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Ms. Abdul Wahith Fathima Rikasa to fill the said vacancy; Therefore I, Aththanayaka Mudiyanselage Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(b) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Ms. Abdul Wahith Fathima Rikasa was selected as the member of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council, Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer, Akkaraipattu Municipal Council. District Election Office, Ampara, 04th November, 2026. EOG 11 – 0030 1A - PG 8135 - 04 (11/2026) PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA. texts.gazette-2514-02: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2514/02 - 2026 යේනාවාැම්බර් මාස 09 වාැනි සඳුදාා - 2026.11.09 No. 2514/02 - MONDAY, NOVEMBER 09, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE MAHARA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of a Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation; AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Mr. Kaluarachchige Athula Jayanth the member who belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(a) of the aforesaid ordinance, to nominate a candidate of that ward Number 26 - Pahala Karagahamuna of Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha, who belongs to such Party and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared Elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Jayasinghe Arachchilage Sumith Ananda to fill the said vacancy; THEREFORE I, Arambage Ayantha Anandi, Returning Officer of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mr. Jayasinghe Arachchilage Sumith Ananda was elected as the member of the ward Number 26 - Pahala Karagahamuna of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha, . A. Ayantha Anandi, Returning Officer, Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Gampaha, 06th of November, 2026.
